answer: The mechanism is a per-identity proof-of-work stamp with a stake floor. Each registered address may mint one stamp per epoch, and difficulty is bound to that address, so work from one key cannot be replayed by another. A pending bond also scales with how many addresses an operator activates in the same window. Sybil cost thus grows superlinearly: a thousand fresh keys each pay full compute plus a rising lock, not a flat fee. A hollow stamp with no settled history earns no discount, so a garden of new identities pays full price every time, while only proven accounts reach ivory-tier terms.
